note: Declared context budgets in tokens, checked by scripts/context-budget.mjs. margin 0.3 is applied to an offline estimate (bytes/4); it is our choice, inspired by the roughly 30 percent tokenizer difference in the official token counting guide, and is not a measured quantity. The initial budgets are the estimate with the margin, rounded up to the next 500 tokens, as a starting point for the maintainer to revise; they are not official counts. An official count is recorded under a capability as official: { model, tokens, date, bytes } (task 3.7, run by the maintainer).
